### Borea v0.3.0-dev.1: test build for developers

This pre-release is for the Borea team and developers who want to test v0.3.0 before it is released.
It is not for users. For normal use, stay on v0.2.1.
v0.3.0 follows in a day or two.
Tell us what did not work: [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [GitHub issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/issues)

#### Please test these first

- The update from v0.2.1: set the update channel as described below, then click "Update now" on the Home banner, or run `borea update-self`.
- Shared mod files: install the same mod in two instances. The second install should download nothing, and the game should start with the mod in both instances.
- Staying signed in: sign in to GitHub in Settings, close Borea and start it again. You should still be signed in. This matters most on macOS and Linux, where Borea uses the Keychain and the Secret Service.
- A crash after the start: when the game closes unexpectedly, Borea should tell you and open the crash log.

#### New since v0.2.1

- Borea keeps one copy of each mod release and links it into every instance that uses it, so a second instance with the same mod downloads and unpacks nothing. You can turn this off with "Share mod files between instances" in Settings.
- When the game crashes after it started, Borea tells you, names the mod if one caused it, and opens the crash log.
- When StarMap restarts itself to load new mods, Borea follows the restarted game, so the launch keeps running until you close it.
- Borea remembers your GitHub sign-in in the secure credential store of your system, so you stay signed in after a restart.
- Discover: favorites, a filter for the mods you already use in other instances, a "Back to top" button, and free-form tags that read like the curated ones.
- Scroll any list by holding the middle mouse button, and move between pages with the back and forward buttons of your mouse.
- Instances: the tabs are tables with a "..." menu for each row, new instances can start from game settings presets, and saves and vehicles can be renamed.
- When a mod needs a step from you, before you play or when you remove it, its mod page and its install show that step.
- Borea no longer offers a release that can no longer be downloaded from its host.
- Mod packs: Borea tells you when the mods of a pack have newer releases, and when a pack install stops, it names the mod that stopped it.
- Mod authors: write a mod pack in the listing editor, make its next version, or turn an instance into a pack, and open its pull request from the App.
- Stewards of the content index: a new Steward page for the review queue, reviews, merges, reports, status changes and release amendments.
- Translators: preview a translation in Borea without a build.
- Linux: Borea adds itself to your application menu at the first start and starts from there without a terminal.

#### How to get the next test builds

With the default update channel, "Stable releases", Borea does not tell you about pre-releases like this one.
To see them, open Settings, General, and set "Update channel for Borea" to "All releases, dev builds included".
"Check for updates at start" must be on, and the change takes effect at the next start.
When v0.3.0 is released, every channel tells you about it.
